title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and collection policies for Intune-protected mobile apps
summary: The roadmap dates and scope match the record, and Microsoft's documentation supports the existing Intune and collection-policy controls. The briefing distinguishes those controls from the planned mobile integration and appropriately leaves its default, licensing and configuration details open.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Purview DLP capability for Intune MAM-protected mobile apps.
claims.quote: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: The planned integration evaluates clipboard actions against content-aware Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed.
claims.quote: This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed

claims.claim: The roadmap also plans collection policies to govern sensitive-data handling in mobile apps.
claims.quote: Additionally, Microsoft Purview Collection policies can be used to govern how sensitive data is being handled in mobile apps.

claims.claim: Existing Intune app protection policy documentation describes targeting apps integrated with the Intune SDK.
claims.quote: All Apps includes all Microsoft and partner apps that have integrated the Intune SDK.

claims.claim: The Intune route is Apps > Protection > Create policy > iOS/iPadOS > Basics > Apps > Data protection > Restrict cut, copy and paste between other apps.
claims.quote: Select Apps > Protection. ... Select Create policy and select either iOS/iPadOS or Android. ... On the Basics page ... Apps page ... Data protection page. This page provides settings for data loss prevention (DLP) controls, including cut, copy, paste, and save-as restrictions.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections creates an Intune iOS managed app protection policy.
claims.quote: Create a new iosManagedAppProtection object. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections

claims.claim: The Graph create operation sets clipboard sharing through allowedOutboundClipboardSharingLevel in its request body.
claims.quote: allowedOutboundClipboardSharingLevel ... The level to which the clipboard may be shared between apps on the managed device. ... The possible values are: allApps, managedAppsWithPasteIn, managedApps, blocked.

claims.claim: The shown Graph operation creates an iOS/iPadOS policy rather than an Android policy.
claims.quote: Create a new iosManagedAppProtection object.

claims.claim: Collection policy activity selection is reached through Purview Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies > + Create policy > + Add activities.
claims.quote: Open the Data loss prevention solution and navigate to Classifiers > Collection policies. ... Select + Create policy. ... Select + Add activities.

claims.claim: New-FeatureConfiguration -Name <policy-name> -FeatureScenario KnowYourData -Mode Enable -ScenarioConfig <collection-policy-JSON> creates an enabled collection policy.
claims.quote: New-FeatureConfiguration -Name "Collection policy for supported Copilots" -FeatureScenario KnowYourData -Mode Enable -ScenarioConfig ... This example creates an enabled collection policy
